parole.testo: From Vulgar Latin *hanca, from Proto-Germanic *hankō (related to *ankijǭ (“joint, limb”)). Compare French hanche and English haunch.

parole.significato: welcome (whose arrival is a cause of joy)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese bem vindo, from Vulgar Latin *bene venītus, presumably a calque of a Frankish term, derived from Proto-Germanic *wiljakwemô (“a welcome guest or arrival”), from which many modern Germanic forms descend, such as English welcome. By surface analysis, bem (“well”)
From Vulgar Latin *taxūcus, from Late Latin taxō, ultimately from Proto-Germanic *þahsuz.
